decisionRequired: Admit both legacy success and current succeeded status generations, or explicitly authorize a status migration before view replacement.

proposedViewPolicy.orderBy: packet_key, source_revision, pass_type, pass_revision, input_hash, created_at DESC, id DESC
proposedViewPolicy.reason: Preserve readable legacy history and current typed-writer rows while making duplicate selection deterministic.

live.deployedViewDefinition:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (packet_key, source_revision, pass_type, pass_revision, input_hash) id,
    packet_key,
    source_revision,
    pass_type,
    pass_revision,
    input_hash,
    status,
    output,
    scores,
    provenance,
    model_name,
    prompt_hash,
    temperature,
    created_at,
    updated_at
   FROM analysis_pass_results
  WHERE status = 'success'::text
  ORDER BY packet_key, source_revision, pass_type, pass_revision, input_hash, created_at DESC;
